dataset: synthetic isolated SQLite and Markdown vault; no user data
notes: Five samples make p95 an approximate upper sample, not a production service-level guarantee.
The benchmark confirms unchanged-file synchronization skips reparsing, but retrieval scans all candidates and takes about 555 ms p95 at 10,000 records.
No previous implementation baseline was measured; this report is a reproducible current-state baseline for later optimization comparisons.
